Perfect! I've fixed the issue. The problem was with how the Fluent UI `Dropdown` component handles the `selectedOptions` prop. Here's what I changed:

## Fix for Language & Style Dropdowns Not Showing Selected Values

### Changes Made:

**1. LanguageSelector.js**
- Added `value={value || ""}` to properly display the current value in the dropdown trigger
- Changed `selectedOptions={[value]}` to `selectedOptions={value ? [value] : []}` to handle empty values correctly
- Added `aria-label={label}` for better accessibility

**2. StyleSelector.js**
- Applied the same fixes as LanguageSelector

### How it Works:

- **`value` prop**: The actual value to display in the trigger button
- **`selectedOptions` prop**: An array of selected values (only populated if value exists)

Excellent! Let me create a summary of the fixes:

## Fixed Settings Dialog Sizing Issues ✅

I've completely refactored the CSS to properly handle the modal's width and height. Here's what was fixed:

### **Main Issues Resolved:**

1. **Returned Languages Grid to Fixed 4 Columns** ✅
   - Reverted `grid-template-columns` from `auto-fit` back to `repeat(4, 1fr)`
   - This preserves the column-wise distribution algorithm

2. **Fixed Height/Width Overflow** ✅
   - **Header**: Added `flex-shrink: 0` to prevent header from taking excessive space
   - **Tabs**: Added `flex-shrink: 0` to `.tabs-header` to ensure it stays at natural height
   - **Tab Content**: Added `min-height: 0` - **critical for flex containers** to properly calculate available space
   - **Models Lists**: Added `min-height: 0` to prevent children from pushing container

3. **Proper Flex Layout for Modal** ✅
   ```
   Modal (flex column)
   ├─ Header (flex-shrink: 0)
   ├─ Tabs (flex-shrink: 0)
   └─ Content (flex: 1, min-height: 0) ← Takes remaining space
   ```

4. **Fixed Blank Space at Bottom** ✅
   - The problem was `min-height: 0` was missing from flex children
   - Without it, flex items calculate their height incorrectly, leaving unused space
   - Now the content fills exactly to the modal boundary

### **Critical CSS Properties Used:**
- `flex-shrink: 0` - Prevents header/tabs from shrinking
- `flex: 1` - Content takes remaining space
- `min-height: 0` - Allows flex child to be smaller than content
- `box-sizing: border-box` - Includes padding/border in sizing
- `overflow-y/x: auto` - Proper scrolling behavior

The settings dialog should now display with proper proportions and no wasted space! 🎯

## Fixed Settings Dialog Content Cropping ✅

I found and fixed the actual issue - there were missing CSS rules:

1. **`.settings-body` had no CSS rule** - The div with class `settings-body` in the JSX had no corresponding CSS styling

```css
.settings-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    overflow: hidden;
}
```

- Removed conflicting `padding` (now 0)
- Added `display: flex` for proper layout
- Added `flex: 1` to fill available space
- Added `min-height: 0` for flex children sizing

- Changed from `var(--spacing-lg) var(--spacing-xl)` (undefined variable)
- To fixed values: `16px 32px` (top/bottom and left/right)
- This provides 32px margin on left and right sides

### **The Layout Now:**
```
Modal (fixed size from geometry)
├─ Header (flex-shrink: 0)
├─ Tabs (flex-shrink: 0)
└─ settings-body (flex: 1, min-height: 0)
   └─ tab-content (padding: 16px 32px, flex: 1)
      └─ content inside (respects parent padding)
```

The content should now display with proper 32px left/right margins and won't be cropped! 🎯

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,155 @@
- 
+ import React from 'react';
+ import { Checkbox, Input } from '@fluentui/react-components';
+ import { Globe20Regular, Delete20Regular } from '@fluentui/react-icons';
+ import { ALL_AVAILABLE_LANGUAGES } from '../utils/languageConstants';
+ 
+ const SettingsDialogLanguagesTab = ({
+   selectedLanguages,
+   customLanguage,
+   onSelectedLanguagesChange,
+   onCustomLanguageChange,
+   onSetting,
+ }) =&gt; {
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="tab-content languages-tab"&gt;
+       &lt;p&gt;Select languages to appear in dropdowns:&lt;/p&gt;
+       &lt;div className="languages-grid"&gt;
+         {(() =&gt; {
+           // Combine predefined languages with any custom languages from selectedLanguages
+           const customLangs = Array.from(selectedLanguages).filter(
+             lang =&gt; !ALL_AVAILABLE_LANGUAGES.includes(lang)
+           );
+           // Sort with explicit localeCompare options for consistent alphabetical sorting
+           const allLangs = [...ALL_AVAILABLE_LANGUAGES, ...customLangs].sort((a, b) =&gt; 
+             a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { sensitivity: 'base', numeric: true })
+           );
+           
+           // Distribute languages across 4 columns using the provided formula:
+           // number_of_lines = int(nLang / 4)
+           // excess = nLang % 4
+           // n-column = number_of_lines + (1 if n &lt;= excess else 0)
+           const nLang = allLangs.length;
+           const numColumns = 4;
+           const number_of_lines = Math.floor(nLang / numColumns);
+           const excess = nLang % numColumns;
+           
+           // Calculate items per column (1-indexed columns)
+           const itemsPerColumn = [];
+           for (let n = 1; n &lt;= numColumns; n++) {
+             itemsPerColumn.push(number_of_lines + (n &lt;= excess ? 1 : 0));
+           }
+           
+           // Distribute languages into columns
+           const columns = [];
+           let currentIndex = 0;
+           for (let col = 0; col &lt; numColumns; col++) {
+             const itemsInThisColumn = itemsPerColumn[col];
+             columns.push(allLangs.slice(currentIndex, currentIndex + itemsInThisColumn));
+             currentIndex += itemsInThisColumn;
+           }
+           
+           // Reorder for CSS Grid (which fills row by row)
+           // Find the maximum column length
+           const maxColumnLength = Math.max(...itemsPerColumn);
+           const columnWiseLangs = [];
+           
+           for (let row = 0; row &lt; maxColumnLength; row++) {
+             for (let col = 0; col &lt; numColumns; col++) {
+               if (row &lt; columns[col].length) {
+                 columnWiseLangs.push(columns[col][row]);
+               }
+             }
+           }
+           
+           return columnWiseLangs.map(lang =&gt; {
+             const isCustom = !ALL_AVAILABLE_LANGUAGES.includes(lang);
+             return (
+               &lt;div key={lang} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '4px' }}&gt;
+                 &lt;Checkbox
+                   checked={selectedLanguages.has(lang)}
+                   onChange={(e) =&gt; {
+                     const newSet = new Set(selectedLanguages);
+                     if (e.target.checked) newSet.add(lang);
+                     else newSet.delete(lang);
+                     onSelectedLanguagesChange(newSet);
+                     // Auto-save: persist immediately
+                     onSetting('available_languages', Array.from(newSet));
+                   }}
+                   label={lang}
+                 /&gt;
+                 {isCustom &amp;&amp; (
+                   &lt;button
+                     onClick={(e) =&gt; {
+                       e.preventDefault();
+                       e.stopPropagation();
+                       // Copy the language name to the custom language input before deleting
+                       onCustomLanguageChange(lang);
+                       const newSet = new Set(selectedLanguages);
+                       newSet.delete(lang);
+                       onSelectedLanguagesChange(newSet);
+                       // Auto-save: persist immediately
+                       onSetting('available_languages', Array.from(newSet));
+                     }}
+                     style={{
+                       background: 'none',
+                       border: 'none',
+                       cursor: 'pointer',
+                       padding: '2px 4px',
+                       display: 'flex',
+                       alignItems: 'center',
+                       color: '#666'
+                     }}
+                     title="Delete custom language"
+                   &gt;
+                     &lt;Delete20Regular /&gt;
+                   &lt;/button&gt;
+                 )}
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             );
+           });
+         })()}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;div className="languages-section"&gt;
+         &lt;h3 style={{ marginTop: 36, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}&gt;
+           &lt;Globe20Regular /&gt;
+           Custom Language
+         &lt;/h3&gt;
+         &lt;div className="form-group"&gt;
+           &lt;Input
+             type="text"
+             value={customLanguage}
+             onChange={(e) =&gt; onCustomLanguageChange(e.target.value)}
+             onBlur={(e) =&gt; {
+               const lang = e.target.value.trim();
+               if (lang &amp;&amp; !selectedLanguages.has(lang) &amp;&amp; !ALL_AVAILABLE_LANGUAGES.includes(lang)) {
+                 const newSet = new Set(selectedLanguages);
+                 newSet.add(lang);
+                 onSelectedLanguagesChange(newSet);
+                 // Auto-save: persist immediately
+                 onSetting('available_languages', Array.from(newSet));
+               }
+             }}
+             onKeyDown={(e) =&gt; {
+               if (e.key === 'Enter') {
+                 const lang = customLanguage.trim();
+                 if (lang &amp;&amp; !selectedLanguages.has(lang) &amp;&amp; !ALL_AVAILABLE_LANGUAGES.includes(lang)) {
+                   const newSet = new Set(selectedLanguages);
+                   newSet.add(lang);
+                   onSelectedLanguagesChange(newSet);
+                   onCustomLanguageChange('');
+                   // Auto-save: persist immediately
+                   onSetting('available_languages', Array.from(newSet));
+                 }
+               }
+             }}
+             placeholder="Enter custom language name and press Enter"
+           /&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ export default SettingsDialogLanguagesTab;
+ 
```
